children: US energy-saving tech firm's Q3 revenue fell 65% yr/yr, missing analyst expectations
Gross margin dropped to 37.5% from 64.2% due to lower volume and product mix
Company attributed lower Q3 revenue primarily to the war in Iran, while megaproject sales fell 95%
Company did not provide specific financial guidance in its press release
MEGAPROJECT SALES DROP - Revenue from megaprojects fell sharply, contributing to overall revenue decline
LOWER VOLUME AND PRODUCT MIX - Co said gross margin drop was mainly due to lower sales volume, product mix and higher indirect manufacturing costs
LOWER OPERATING EXPENSES - Co said operating expenses fell due to reduced employee compensation and consulting costs
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is no "strong buy" or "buy", 4 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the industrial machinery & equipment peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Energy Recovery, Inc. is $8.00, about 11.6% above its November 3 closing price of $7.17
The stock recently traded at 30 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 29 three months ago
